title: Ceiling Christoffel prefix-minimizes the exponent walk among admissible words
statement: Among all nonnegative exponent walks with a prescribed (L, o), the ceiling Christoffel word of slope o/L satisfies a_k(w_Chr) <= a_k(w) for every k (equivalently u_k(w_Chr) <= u_k(w)), and therefore attains the walk-charge maximum.
mathematical_domain: Juggler cycle finance / exponent-walk optimal control
tested_range: all feasible (L, o) with L <= 24; leftover maximizers at L = 19, 84, 1054; Christoffel charge vs committed 19-row walk-charge survey at floor 26254995; mechanical prefix 10^5
counterexamples: (L,o)=(4,3): ceiling Christoffel is OOOE with a_3=3; greedy E-when-legal is OOEO with a_3=2; both are admissible
Survey family offsets (e.g. L=51562, 180467): certified walk DP B exceeds streamed Christoffel B by up to 1.50e-3; exact match only on seed multiples 50508, 101016, 151524, 176251
notes: Prefix dominance and greedy=Christoffel do hold on the short near-convergents of 1/(1+log2(3/2)) and on leftover L=19,84,1054. The mechanical average C_*=0.047947 at the 50508 reduced base matches seed leftover C. The charge maximizer is the greedy hugging itinerary, which coincides with Christoffel only near the critical slope. This is a statement about the u>=0 relaxation, not about realized cycle itineraries. The leftover-cell slogan stays refuted. Uniform B/theta<1 at a fixed floor stays false. Not a halt theorem.
